From: adjuster@synthetic-carrier.example
To: intake@synthetic-law.example
Date: July 2, 2026
Subject: Class/collective wage-hour thread with conflicting opt-in estimates

The current synthetic matter concerns Sofia Patel v. Meridian Hospitality Group LLC. The thread contains class allegations, collective allegations, PAGA-style representative allegations, and competing opt-in estimates. One sender says there are 52 current opt-in candidates; quoted payroll notes say there may be 310 putative class members over a three-year lookback. The packet references two timekeeping systems, one payroll system, HRIS, ESI custodians in payroll and operations, a statistical sampling expert, a payroll damages expert, and a possible e-discovery vendor. Forum and arbitration posture is unknown. Treat these competing opt-in estimates as alternatives until human review.

-----Original Message-----
From: payroll@meridian.example
To: adjuster@synthetic-carrier.example
Subject: RE: Employee counts

The payroll team believes the current opt-in list has 52 people, but the broader putative class may include 310 employees if all banquet and housekeeping job codes are included.

-----Original Message-----
From: operations@meridian.example
To: payroll@meridian.example
Subject: RE: Systems and custodians

Please preserve HRIS, payroll system, timekeeping system, payroll custodian email, operations manager files, and scheduling exports.
